items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So he kept Jimmy, you know.

ctx.x: But we was in Boston and Duke, you know, he couldn't keep him no longer, and so that's when Jimmy Woody got the job. We was playing Storyville. And Jimmy had, Jimmy Woody -- I mean, Duke had Jimmy Woody to come by and try out. So he kept Jimmy, you know.

And I taught him a few things that I knew. I taught him a lot of introductions and things, just like I did to other bass players that came in, like 'Satin Doll' all them introductions and things like that they didn't know and I used to teach them. I used to show them.
